## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the feature/specification.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passed.
- [ ] Relevant integration tests passed, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change; no secrets or generated files are included.

## Target

- Feature PR: base is `dev`.
- Release PR: base is `main`, head is `dev`, and the owner explicitly requested promotion of the completed flow.
